why: Post-2024 results found are all about restricted settings (Cayley/algebraic graphs, random hypergraphs, vertex-cover-bounded graphs, partial cubes) or the strictly weaker 'weak Meyniel conjecture', not the general n-vertex conjecture; the best known general upper bound remains the 2011 Lu-Peng/Scott-Sudakov n/2^{(1-o(1))sqrt(log n)} bound, unimproved.
